entry.title: ATERNUM
entry.text: ATERNUM, s town of Lucerna in Italy, now _Alteris_, (Chorusas )). Alfo a town in the territory of the Piceni, now _Pofcara_, a port-town of Naples, fitu-ated and the infinite. E. Long 15.25. V.Lav. 42.50.
